method: Primary-source web search/open; observations are paraphrases, not copied pages. Moving references are not version-qualified client captures.

sources.observation: Config reference reviewed: no geolocation-off setting found; analytics and provider-header settings have separate semantics.
Optional explicit location lives on web-search tools; a filter must preserve search availability.
Dated preview spelling includes web_search_preview_2025_03_11; covered by a regression fixture.
Optional product location has an account dashboard control. Mandatory security location cannot be disabled.
Reviewed environment reference does not establish a global geolocation-off variable.
Web-search tools accept user_location; preserve domain controls and max_uses.
Usage statistics settings are distinct from location consent.
Maps grounding documents optional toolConfig.retrievalConfig.latLng; fetched as markdown by search, web open refused that content type.
Usage reporting has its own privacy setting and environment override, independent of inference provider.
Provider baseURL is configurable, enabling the existing Router endpoint.
Agent identifies itself as a thin OpenCode-based agent.
This is the integrated CLI; configurable GROK_BASE_URL differs from consumer site settings.
Policy describes IP-derived geography. Router private-protocol integration remains unsupported.
Privacy Mode concerns code training/retention; not a verified geolocation switch.
Visitor location headers can contain IP-derived country, city and coordinates; IP-header stripping alone is insufficient.
Canonical headers include cf-region, cf-region-code, cf-metro-code, cf-postal-code and cf-timezone; regression fixtures include them in addition to ip-prefixed fields.
